Théoden stands atop the Hornburg with his trusted guard, ready to command his forces in the coming battle. Upon the Deeping Wall, ranks of Men and Elves stand side-by-side with one another, honouring the allegiance that stood between Elendil and Gil-galad over three thousand years ago."
